Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & 6 \\ 8 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 2 & -5\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1\cdot 1+6\cdot 2 & 1\cdot 0+6\cdot (-5) \\ 8\cdot 1+(-3)\cdot 2 & 8\cdot 0+(-3)\cdot (-5)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+12 & 0+(-30) \\ 8+(-6) & 0+15\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}13 & -30 \\ 2 & 15\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
